## SEO Agent — AI Pilot API (W2-FIX)
`POST /webhook/seo-ai-pilot` (header X-API-Key, credential **SEO API Key**): `{ domain | site_id, confirm?, callback_url?, request_id? }` -> 202 at once; starts **SEO Agent — AI Repeat Pilot** (`SEOagentAIPilot1`) through its Manual Run. Without `confirm: true` the pilot answers with its price (callback stage `ai_pilot_quote`) and asks nothing; with it, it runs once (at most $4) and reports through stage `ai_pilot`. On demand only, never scheduled.
